tasks.title: Brain API — 新增 GET /initiative-runs 列表查询端点
tasks.scope: 在 packages/brain/src/routes/harness.js 现有 GET /initiative-runs/:id 路由之前新增 GET /initiative-runs 路由（无路径参数），查询 initiative_runs 表，SELECT id/initiative_id/phase/journey_type/journey_id/created_at/completed_at/deadline_at/failure_reason/cost_usd::float，支持 phase/journey_id/limit 查询参数（limit 默认 50 最大 100，journey_id 须通过 UUID_RE 校验，phase 为空字符串时忽略），ORDER BY created_at DESC，返回 {runs[], total} 结构
dod: [BEHAVIOR] GET /initiative-runs 无参数返回 HTTP 200，顶层 keys 精确等于 ['runs','total']
[BEHAVIOR] total 等于 runs 数组实际长度
[BEHAVIOR] runs 每条含 id/initiative_id/phase/journey_type/journey_id/created_at/completed_at/deadline_at/failure_reason/cost_usd 共 10 字段
[BEHAVIOR] cost_usd 序列化为 number 或 null（使用 cost_usd::float）
[BEHAVIOR] limit 非整数/<1/>100 → HTTP 400，error 含 'invalid limit: must be integer 1-100'
[BEHAVIOR] journey_id 非 UUID → HTTP 400，error == 'invalid journey_id: must be a UUID'
[BEHAVIOR] phase 为空字符串 → 忽略过滤，正常返回 200
[ARTIFACT] SQL 含 ORDER BY created_at DESC
